note.en: The Mahābhārata's river catalogue (Bhīṣma 6.9.14-38) names some 130 rivers 'as memory serves'. Twenty-one that can be matched to a modern river are drawn on it under the old name. Most of the rest cannot be placed.
note.hi: महाभारत की नदी-सूची (भीष्मपर्व 6.9.14-38) 'जैसा स्मरण है' लगभग 130 नदियाँ गिनाती है। जिन इक्कीस का किसी आधुनिक नदी से मेल बैठता है, वे पुराने नाम से उसी पर खींची गई हैं। बाक़ी अधिकतर पहचानी नहीं जा सकतीं।

attribution: Names from Mahābhārata 6.9 as quoted in the Jñānakośa from sa.wikisource; drawn on the same India-WRIS river lines as the Rivers layer.
_about: Items are generated by the Jñānakośa gazetteer (~/dev/jnanakosha: python3 tools/kosha_gazetteer.py export <this checkout>); edit gazetteer/places.json there, not items.json here. Every item's verse is a verbatim form from a quoted, revision-pinned sa.wikisource page; the identification is kept apart and graded, and only certain or likely places inside India are drawn.
